status: frozen when the campaign manifest pins this file's sha256; applied once by rl/m7p_analysis.decide; never re-decided
experiment: three fresh runs of btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4 + btt_reward_v2 (m7p_geo4_s{0,1,2}, 3,072,000 policy transitions each, tick-0 starts only) against the M7n v3 runs m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3 (btt_policy_obs_v3_entities + btt_reward_v2, the same profiles except contracts.observation) as the matched control, paired by seed
question: Does scaling only the segment_geometry block of the v3 observation by 1/4 (btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4) let PPO learn more Mario Break the Targets from normal tick-0 starts than v3 at the same budget: a native-verified clear, a replay-verified qualified crossing or left-target break, or more targets per episode in every seed?
only_difference: contracts.observation: btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4 instead of btt_policy_obs_v3_entities (segment_geometry length columns / 8,000 instead of / 2,000 and velocity columns / 200 instead of / 50; every other key, flag, the network, PPO, reward v2, Track 1, the lifecycle and the budget identical); compatibility views differ only in contracts.observation

exp.initialisation: fresh model and optimizer state (the profile's construction; ckpt_000000000 must equal the fresh construction AND the M7n run's initial set of the same seed, which the identical seed, architecture and shapes make byte-identical); nothing imported from the geo4 diagnostic run (runs/m7p/diag) or any other run

ctl.reuse_condition: runs/m7p/campaign/_control/control_check.json PASS (R1: fresh 102,400-transition runs of the M7n profiles equal the M7n runs' ckpt_000102400 digests and episode rows in every seed) AND runs/m7p/campaign/_control/control_verify.json PASS (the M7n final and initial evaluation records verified, their tick-0 checks re-run, their clear and crossing candidate sets re-enumerated, every rule input recomputed and equal to the recorded M7n analysis) on the manifest's code fingerprint and executable; a failed check stops the campaign; replacement controls are never trained by this rule

matched: btt_policy_net_v3_multiinput_mlp64 (tanh [64, 64]); norm_obs False in both arms
PPO of rl/configs/m7n: 3e-4, rollout 5,120 = 5 x 1,024, batch 512, 10 epochs, gamma 0.999, lambda 0.995, clip 0.2, ent_coef 0, vf_coef 0.5, max_grad_norm 0.5
N = 5 workers with one standby each (<= 10 game processes)
horizon 3,600; tick-0 starts only; no curriculum, prefix, anchor, archive or exploration credit
3,072,000 policy transitions per run; checkpoints every 102,400

the M7n evaluation protocol: initial + 9 curve points + final; 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic at initial and final, 60 + 5 at curve points; evaluation seed 12345; frozen parameters; btt_eval_metrics_v1; every checkpoint evaluated under its own observation contract; every native clear replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process; every gate-2 candidate replayed and analysed by btt_qualified_crossing_v1

populations_and_denominators.final label: the final checkpoint set (3,072,000 transitions) of a run, evaluated post hoc from tick 0 under the run's own observation contract: 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic episodes
populations_and_denominators.initial label: the run's own ckpt_000000000, 100 stochastic episodes (used for G of the experimental arm only)
populations_and_denominators.K[a][s]: native-verified clears over the 200 final episodes of the run (100 stochastic + 100 deterministic)
populations_and_denominators.X[a][s]: 1 iff at least one of the 100 final STOCHASTIC episodes has a replay-verified qualified crossing or a replay-verified left-target break (crossing_verification); the deterministic play is diagnostic
populations_and_denominators.T[a][s]: mean targets broken (exact Fraction) over the final stochastic episodes that are not verified clears; UNDEFINED (null) when that set is empty, never 0
populations_and_denominators.D[s]: T[exp][s] - T[ctl][s]; undefined when either is undefined
populations_and_denominators.G[s]: T of exp's final label minus T of exp's initial label; undefined when either is undefined
populations_and_denominators.diagnostics (never gating): L (target 2 by tick <= 2699 with >= 5 static right targets), R (all seven right targets by 2699), target-2 breaks and ticks, falls, seven-right episodes, deterministic collapse share (M7e definition), unqualified left entries, the per-checkpoint curves, and the offline saturation / sensitivity measurements of the manifest's measurement plan

native_verified_clear: an episode counts as a clear only when its canonical native actions, replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process, reproduce completion_time_passed AND completion_input_tick exactly (rl/m7g_k_run.verify_clears_in); a native clear that does not reproduce is an integrity problem

qualified_crossing_or_left_target_break.criterion: btt_qualified_crossing_v1 (rl/m7n_crossing.py): candidates = final stochastic episodes with a btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry or a left target in broken_ids; each replayed exactly from tick 0 (digest, consumed ticks, all actions, break table, first-left-entry tick); qualified crossing = over_wall entry (btt_reward_v3.classify_entry) AND btt_crossing_evidence_v1 path over_ledge AND a grounded takeoff AND a landing on a decoded left-side floor line inside the same left visit (not the failure step); left-target break = target 1, 6 or 8 in the exact replay's break table; a raw left entry or an off-stage fall is never a crossing; an inexact candidate is an integrity problem
qualified_crossing_or_left_target_break.arms: the same procedure and code path on the experimental finals and on the control finals (the control's documents already exist from M7n and are re-verified by control_verify; a control candidate that qualifies sets X[ctl][s] = 1)

conditions_any: the control reproduction check (R1) or the control record verification is missing, failed or bound to another code fingerprint / executable / rule

an experimental run is not verified (identity, fresh start equal to the fresh construction and to the M7n initial set of its seed, provenance, rows, leak-free, geo4 contract id and digest in run.json and every checkpoint)
an evaluation label of either arm fails its verification (episode count, frozen parameters, tick-0 starts, metrics, artifacts, the checkpoint's own observation contract)
a native clear of either arm not reproduced by its replay
a gate-2 candidate of either arm whose replay is not exact, or a crossing document whose candidate set differs from the label's rows
a control label or a control checkpoint changed since the manifest
integrity_gate.action: stop; no decision is recorded; diagnose

conditions_any: fewer than three verified experimental runs
an experimental final label without 100 + 100 episodes or an initial label without 100 stochastic
a missing crossing verification of an experimental final
a stopped, failed or partial experimental run (preserved, never resumed)
incomplete.action: no decision; reported as incomplete, never as failure or inconclusive

gates_in_order.name: first_clear
gates_in_order.condition: (sum_s K[exp][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[ctl][s] == 0) or (K[exp][s] > K[ctl][s] for every seed)
gates_in_order.action: every verified clear and its checkpoint preserved permanently; geo4 selected as the Track 1 observation for the next milestone

gates_in_order.name: control_clear_guard
gates_in_order.condition: sum_s K[ctl][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[exp][s] == 0: gates 2 and 4 cannot select the experimental arm (K[ctl] is 0 today; the guard is kept for symmetry)

gates_in_order.name: ceiling_broken
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; X[exp][s] == 1 in at least ceiling_seeds_min (2) seeds and X[ctl][s] == 0 in every seed
gates_in_order.action: geo4 selected for the next milestone; the qualified crossings / left-target breaks are already replayed and their traces, routes and landings documented

gates_in_order.name: target_regression
gates_in_order.condition: D defined in at least regression_seeds_min seeds and D[s] <= -targets_diff_min (-1/2) in at least regression_seeds_min (2) seeds
gates_in_order.action: geo4 recorded as worse at this budget; v3 stays selected; no extension, no retune

gates_in_order.name: better_targets
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; D defined in every seed and D[s] >= +targets_diff_min (+1/2) in every seed (the M7n paired threshold: per episode, paired by seed, no pooling)
gates_in_order.action: geo4 selected for the next milestone on target count, as M7n selected v3 over v1; not a clear, not a crossing, not evidence about the ceiling

gates_in_order.name: no_learning
gates_in_order.condition: at least no_learning_seeds_min seeds with G defined and G[s] <= 0 in at least no_learning_seeds_min (2) seeds
gates_in_order.action: geo4 did not learn from scratch at this budget; v3 stays selected

gates_in_order.name: no_discovery_no_difference
gates_in_order.condition: anything else: neither a discovery event (gates 1-2) nor the regression threshold (gate 3) nor the improvement threshold in every seed (gate 4) nor no-learning (gate 5)
gates_in_order.action: v3 stays selected; geo4 stays available and documented; this rule unlocks no extension

precedence: gate 0 first; then incompleteness; then gates 1-6 in order and the FIRST applicable gate whose condition holds decides. Discovery (gates 1-2) takes precedence over target regression (gate 3): when a discovery gate holds AND gate 3's condition also holds, the outcome is the discovery outcome with the flag target_regression = true and the label suffix '_with_target_regression'; every gate's condition is evaluated and reported whatever decides. An inapplicable gate (undefined inputs) never decides and evaluation continues.
selection: geo4 is selected only by gates 1, 2 or 4; every other outcome (invalid, incomplete, failure_regression, failure_no_learning, inconclusive) keeps btt_policy_obs_v3_entities selected. Lower first-layer saturation, retained sensitivity or any other offline measurement is reported as a supporting diagnostic and is NEVER sufficient to select geo4.

ties_and_boundaries.clears: equal clear counts in a seed are not 'more'; gate 1's second form needs strictly more in EVERY seed
ties_and_boundaries.D: D exactly -1/2 counts for gate 3; D exactly +1/2 counts for gate 4; exact Fractions, never floats
ties_and_boundaries.G: G exactly 0 counts as no learning
ties_and_boundaries.X: an unqualified left entry (through-face, under-stage or no landing) never sets X
ties_and_boundaries.seed_disagreement: improvement in two seeds and regression in one is gate 6 (inconclusive) unless the regression threshold is met in two seeds (gate 3)

undefined_quantities.representation: JSON null in every report; Fractions otherwise; never a substituted 0
undefined_quantities.T: undefined when every stochastic episode of the label is a verified clear
undefined_quantities.D: undefined when T[exp][s] or T[ctl][s] is undefined
undefined_quantities.G: undefined when T of exp's final or initial label is undefined
undefined_quantities.gate_3: inapplicable unless D is defined in at least regression_seeds_min seeds
undefined_quantities.gate_4: inapplicable unless D is defined in every seed
undefined_quantities.gate_5: a seed with undefined G never counts; inapplicable when fewer than no_learning_seeds_min seeds have G defined
undefined_quantities.consequence: an all-clear exp label with no control clear is gate 1 by K alone; all-clear labels in both arms with equal counts are an inconclusive tie (gates 3-5 inapplicable), never a fabricated difference

supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.saturation_and_sensitivity: the manifest's offline measurement plan (fixed 33,997-state sample rebuilt under each arm's own contract; actor / critic layer-1 sat95, derivative, stuck units on the policy-play and random-play populations; break-pair abs dV and KL; up-B progress KL vs its control pairs; agent / targets / geometry block ablation KL) at the registered checkpoints 0, 307,200, 614,400, ..., 2,764,800 and final of both arms; reported in the analysis record; decides nothing; a persisting saturation reduction is reported as such and is not a success
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.curves: per-checkpoint stochastic target means of both arms (60-episode labels; 100 at initial and final); reported, never gating
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.training_behaviour: training episodes, falls, tracker targets, throughput; reported, never an outcome

not_evidence_of_success: lower saturation, higher derivative or retained sensitivity (supporting diagnostics only)
a higher target mean in one or two seeds (gate 4 needs every seed)
a raw left entry, an off-stage fall on the left, an unqualified crossing
training-time tracker counts or native clears during training (training behaviour, always reported separately)
the geo4 diagnostic's 60-episode result (one seed, 307,200 transitions, stop-only band)
reported_always: K, X, T, D, G per seed and pooled
target-2 breaks and ticks, L, R, falls, seven-right, left entries, left-target breaks per arm and seed
deterministic collapse share per arm and seed
saturation / sensitivity measurements at the registered checkpoints
stops: a training or evaluation verification failure
a failed control check or record verification
an inexact replay of a clear or crossing candidate
decision_recording: once, by `python rl/m7p_campaign.py analyze`, into runs/m7p/campaign/_matrix/analysis_n3.json and state.json; the outcome is never re-decided; the human-readable report cites the record
